## Runs 6 + 7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`): electron n_geo = +3.2×10¹² (0 → 10 T, run 6), hole n_geo = −1.2×10¹² (10 → 0.3 T, run 7)

Raw Rxx (sr1 = B_1−B_2, 10 nA, τ 0.3 s, 50 µV) vs B and vs 1/B, then `sdh_onset` per-tone table. **Read, run 6 (electron):** oscillations from ~1 T, QH-like minima with Rxx → 0 (slightly negative: Hall admixture in this geometry) at 2.28, 2.70, 3.29, 3.71, 4.30, 6.02, 7.11 T, then a broad 500 Ω maximum 7.8–9.5 T and a dip to 300 Ω at 9.75 T. The adjacent-minima spacing is 4.6 in ν on the geometry-prior density — if those are Δν = 4 gaps the true density is 0.87× n_geo (F_{Δν=4} ≈ 29.5 T, the strongest tone in the table, vs F_L(geo) = 33.1 T): **the 9.5 nm-anchored absolute scale is ~10–13 % high**; the ratio c_bg/c_tg (0.773) is unaffected. Sub-harmonic tones at ≈ F/4 and F/2 (7.1, 14.1 T) mean every 2nd/4th Δν = 4 minimum is deeper — a Δν = 8/16 hierarchy is present but not yet indexable from one cut. **Run 7 (hole):** oscillations from ~0.7 T, Rxx → 0 at 1.68 T, a sharp 330 Ω peak at 2.45 T, then minima at 3.38, 4.92, 6.00, 6.96, 8.36 T (ν_geo 14.7, 10.1, 8.3, 7.1, 5.9 — with a 0.82–0.87 scale these are ν ≈ 12, 8, 7, 6, 5: broken-symmetry odd fillings appear above 5 T), rising to 590 Ω at 10 T; the dominant tone 12.3 T ≈ F_L(geo) 12.4 T, so the hole-side scale error is smaller or the offset differs — a fan question. **Take:** both sides are in the quantum regime by 2 T at T_e ≈ 8 K, the channel is clean (no rail, gate currents at the pA floor, T 1.17–1.29 K), and single cuts cannot fix ν or count line families → a D = 0 Landau fan (plan step 4) is the next measurement; the density calibration will be re-anchored on its LL indexing.

"""Runs 6 + 7 (`sdh-spot-check`, D = 0): raw traces, 1/B view, per-tone onsets (sdh_onset), QH-minima filling factors,
and the density-scale check F_(dnu=4) vs F_L(geometry prior). Re-runnable in the ana kernel (uses run(), file_path)."""
from scipy.signal import find_peaks, savgol_filter
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset, SdhOnsetError

h_over_e = cst.h / cst.e   # T m^2
spots = [(6, +3.2, "electron"), (7, -1.2, "hole")]
fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 8))
summary = {}
for k, (rid, n_geo, side) in enumerate(spots):
    g = run(rid)
    B = g.col("magnet_field"); I = g.col("sr0_X") / (-1e6); R = g.col("sr1_X") / I
    o = np.argsort(B); B, R = B[o], R[o]
    FL = luttinger_frequency(abs(n_geo) * 1e16)
    axs[0, k].plot(B, R, lw=0.7); axs[0, k].set_xlabel("B (T)"); axs[0, k].set_ylabel("Rxx (Ohm)")
    axs[0, k].set_title(f"run {rid} — {side}, n_geo = {n_geo:+.1f}e12, D = 0 (raw Rxx)")
    m = B >= 1.0
    axs[1, k].plot(1 / B[m], R[m], lw=0.7); axs[1, k].set_xlabel("1/B (1/T)"); axs[1, k].set_ylabel("Rxx (Ohm)")
    # QH-like minima above 1.5 T and their filling factor on the geometry-prior density
    Rs = savgol_filter(R[m], 7, 2)
    mins, _ = find_peaks(-Rs, prominence=max(5, 0.05 * Rs.max()))
    Bm, Rm = B[m][mins], Rs[mins]; keep = Bm > 1.5
    nu_geo = abs(n_geo) * 1e16 * h_over_e / Bm
    for b in Bm[keep]: axs[0, k].axvline(b, color="gray", lw=0.4, ls=":")
    print(f"=== run {rid} ({side}): n_geo = {n_geo:+.2f}e12 -> F_L(geo, g=4) = {FL:.1f} T; R(B_min) = {R[0]:.0f} Ohm, max {R.max():.0f} Ohm")
    print("  Rxx minima > 1.5 T: " + ", ".join(f"{b:.2f} T (R {r:.0f}, nu_geo {nu:.1f})" for b, r, nu in zip(Bm[keep], Rm[keep], nu_geo[keep])))
    # spacing of the minima in nu -> Delta-nu = 4 periodicity gives the true density scale
    dnu = -np.diff(nu_geo[keep]); dnu = dnu[(dnu > 2.5) & (dnu < 6)]   # adjacent minima only (skip missed ones)
    scale = 4.0 / np.median(dnu) if len(dnu) else np.nan
    print(f"  adjacent-minima spacing in nu_geo: median {np.median(dnu):.2f} (n={len(dnu)}) -> if these are dnu = 4 gaps, n_true/n_geo = {scale:.3f}")
    try:
        on = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=50e-6 / 10e-9)
        print(on.summary())
        summary[rid] = on
    except SdhOnsetError as e:
        print("  sdh_onset:", e)
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`), n −1.25 … +3.2×10¹² × B 0.5 → 10 T

> **05:26** · landau-fan D=0: n\_geo -1.25..+3.2e12 x179 fast (Vtg,Vbg co-swept, run-5 cal), B slow 0.5->10 T 66 rows (0.1 T to 4 T, 0.2 T above), sr1 100 uV, tau 0.1 s, fast\_delay 1 s; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~10:56** (≈5h30m)

**Why now (plan step 4; operator request).** Runs 6/7 (ana) show clean SdH from ~1 T and QH minima with Rxx → 0 by 2.3 T on the electron side; the Δν = 4 periodicity there sits at F ≈ 29.5 T against F_L(geo) = 33.1 T, so the 9.5 nm-anchored density scale runs ~10 % high and both spot checks carry ambiguous ν assignments (hole side: minima at ν_geo ≈ 10, 8.3, 7.1, 5.9). The fan resolves all of it at once: LL lines indexed by ν give the absolute n calibration; **which ν carry the strong gaps** (ν = 8 hierarchy → Bernal blocks; ν = 16 first, then 4/8/12 → rhombohedral manifold; ν = 4 at low B → a Dirac-like block, ABCB); **one vs two line families** converging on the CNP (two bilayer-like Fermi surfaces vs one); and the ν = 0 / low-ν sector at high B where ABAB and ABCA differ most. Region B (0.43×10¹² electron-doped, run 5) should appear as a ×1.13-density replica of every feature.

**Design.** Fast axis: (V_tg, V_bg) co-swept along the run-5 D = 0 line, n_geo −1.25 → +3.2×10¹² in 0.025 steps (179 pts; TG −0.291 … +0.984 V, BG −0.484 … +1.166 V, ≥ 5 mV inside every validator — the full D = 0 window the operating box allows; the hole side is TG-limited at −1.27). Slow axis: B 0.5 → 4.0 T at 0.1 T, 4.2 → 10 T at 0.2 T (66 rows; the magnet sits at 0 so the fan climbs — no re-traverse; the Δν = 4 line spacing in n is 0.097×10¹²·B, i.e. ≥ 4 fast points from 1 T). Sensitivity fixed at 100 µV (10 kΩ FS; the ν = 0 peak at high B may rail — that is itself a read). **Settling: I set τ 0.3 → 0.1 s on both lock-ins** so fast_delay 1.0 s = 10 τ at 24 dB/oct (settled to 1 %); at the operator's 0.3 s the same dwell would leave ~half of each step unsettled and smear LL minima over ~3 fast points, and 3 s/pt would price the fan at 12 h. Acquisition setting, not a safety surface; state0 restores 0.3 s at close-out. Leak guard (> 1 nA either gate → interrupt) on; sr1 only readout (sr2/sr3 n.c.).

**Price** (run 5: 1.10 s/pt at fast_delay 1 s; run 6: 3 s settle per field set): 66 rows × (179 × 1.15 s + 7 s turnaround) ≈ 3.9 h + ramps 76 min ≈ 5.2 h, realistic ~5.5 h; ends at **10 T** with the gates at n_geo = +3.2. **Checkpoints:** first row (~6 min: CNP peak ≈ 250–300 Ω at 0.5 T as in run 5, no rail beyond the CNP, gate currents at the pA floor, T ≈ 1.2 K); row 15 (2 T, ~1.3 h): LL minima visible along n and converging on the CNP — abort if the rows are featureless or the channel rails across > 5 points/row; row 40 (5 T): interim ν-indexing and line-family count, continue/adjust call written to ana. T_sample > 1.5 K at high B → pause.

# === Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`): n fast along the calibrated D = 0 line, B slow 0.5 -> 10 T ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, absolute scale = 9.5 nm prior;
#     runs 6/7 say the scale runs ~10-13 % high — the fan's LL indexing recalibrates it, so n here is "n_geo") ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_vec = np.round(np.arange(-1.25, 3.2001, 0.025), 4)          # 1e12 cm^-2, 179 pts, D = 0
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, np.zeros_like(n_vec), CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = np.asarray(Vtg_vec, float), np.asarray(Vbg_vec, float)
MARGIN = 0.005   # V — every point strictly inside the committed validators (a throw mid-fan would abort the run)
assert Vtg_vec.min() >= TG_MIN + MARGIN and Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX - MARGIN, (Vtg_vec.min(), Vtg_vec.max())
assert Vbg_vec.min() >= BG_MIN + MARGIN and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX - MARGIN, (Vbg_vec.min(), Vbg_vec.max())
assert len(Vtg_vec) == len(Vbg_vec) == len(n_vec)
_nchk, _Dchk = calc_nD(Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert np.abs(np.asarray(_Dchk)).max() < 1e-6 and np.abs(np.asarray(_nchk) - n_vec).max() < 1e-6
print(f"fast axis: n_geo {n_vec[0]:+.3f} .. {n_vec[-1]:+.3f}e12 ({len(n_vec)} pts, 0.025 step) at D = 0 -> "
      f"Vtg [{Vtg_vec.min():+.4f}, {Vtg_vec.max():+.4f}] V, Vbg [{Vbg_vec.min():+.4f}, {Vbg_vec.max():+.4f}] V "
      f"(validators TG [{TG_MIN}, {TG_MAX}], BG [{BG_MIN}, {BG_MAX}])")

# --- slow axis: uniform-B rows, denser where the fan converges ---
B_vec = np.unique(np.round(np.hstack((np.arange(0.5, 4.0001, 0.1), np.arange(4.2, 10.0001, 0.2))), 3))   # 66 rows, climbing
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and B_vec.min() > 0
print(f"slow axis: B {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T, {len(B_vec)} rows (0.1 T to 4 T, 0.2 T above)")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B| < 0.05: fan climbs from 0), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- lock-in settling: tau 0.3 -> 0.1 s on both lock-ins so fast_delay 1.0 s = 10 tau (24 dB/oct settles to 1 % in ~10 tau);
#     at tau 0.3 s the same dwell leaves ~half of each step unsettled and smears LL minima over ~3 fast points.
#     Acquisition setting, not a safety surface; state0 (close-out restore) holds the operator's 0.3 s.
print(f"tau before: sr0 {sr0.time_constant()} s, sr1 {sr1.time_constant()} s; slope sr1 {sr1.filter_slope()} dB/oct")
sr0.time_constant(0.1); sr1.time_constant(0.1)
# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan (no autorange mid-row): 100 uV = 10 kOhm FS at 10 nA; CNP at high B may rail (that is a read).
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.0, 3.0
I_TRIP = 1e-9
print(f"tau after: sr0 {sr0.time_constant()} s, sr1 {sr1.time_constant()} s; drive {sr1.amplitude()} V -> 10 nA; "
      f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (10 kOhm FS); sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V; fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan D=0: n_geo fast {n_vec[0]:+.3f}..{n_vec[-1]:+.3f}e12 ({len(n_vec)} pts) along D = 0 (run-5 cal), "
                  f"B slow {B_vec[0]}->{B_vec[-1]} T ({len(B_vec)} rows: 0.1 T to 4 T, 0.2 T above), Vsi = 0, sr1 100 uV, tau 0.1 s")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'D = 0 line (run-5 cal: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, c_tg {CAL["c_tg"]:.3e} prior anchor, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.4f}e12, '
              f'D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f} V/nm); fast (Vtg, Vbg) co-swept, n_geo {n_vec[0]:+.3f}..{n_vec[-1]:+.3f}e12 step 0.025 ({len(n_vec)} pts); '
              f'slow B {B_vec[0]}..{B_vec[-1]} T, {len(B_vec)} rows; fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s; tau 0.1 s; sr1 100 uV')

# park the gates at the row start, then climb to the first field row (both blocking)
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_vec[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_vec[0])
interruptible_sleep(5)
s.ramp(magnet.field, B_vec[0])
interruptible_sleep(5)

# row layout: [time, B(slow), Vtg(fast), Vbg(fast), T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f}, Vbg={float(data[3]):+.4f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec],
                 slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY, init_delay=False)
# field stays at 10 T (the next step rides it down), gates stay at the last fast point — no park here.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T_sample = {T_sample():.3f} K")
